title: harness.sh update: defer self-replacement to exit (fix crash)

slices.description: cmd_update never swaps the running script mid-flight; regression test with bin/-bearing fixtures
steps: tests/run.sh: update fixture whose upstream includes bin/harness.sh that changes between old and new; assert exit 0, no 'unbound' diagnostic, installed checksum == new upstream, harness.sh version still runs
cmd_update: read pairs via herestring (no pipe subshell); when dst is the running script, defer the copy
after lockfile move + log + tmpclone cleanup: copy deferred script last, then exit 0
